newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India one-day rally peters out.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India one-day rally peters out.

text.p: A rally on Wednesday in Indian global depositary receipts petered out on Thursday as the Bombay Stock Exchange turned lower on its second day of trading after a holiday earlier this week.

"The GDRs followed the locals lower, people are not buying ahead of the new issue for State Bank of India," said a trader. State Bank of India is to raise $400 million from a new issue, which is roadshowing in London next week.
The James Capel Indian GDR Index fell 0.92 points, or 1.29 percent to 69.96 points, a premium of 14.39 percent over the local market, where the BSE 30 index fell 64.24 points to 3,349.77.

"I expect to see some bottom fishing in the market on Friday and Monday, but it is not surprising to see the GDRs and locals down. The imposition of minimum corporate tax, petrol price rises and the economic slowdown are bound to have an impact on earnings," said the trader.

Other Asian markets were also weaker, with the Capel Korea Index down 1.31 points, 1.93 percent to 66.16 points, a premium of 25.89 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite Index fell 8.95 points to 773.15.
The Capel Taiwan Index fell 0.31 points, 0.35 percent to 89.57 points, a premium of 3.37 percent over the local market after the Taiwan Weighted Index rose 36.57 points to 6,535.59.
